Staff Software Engineer, Frontend Platform
Northwind Labs - Remote (US)

Northwind Labs builds scheduling software for clinics. Our frontend platform team owns the shared
Vue component library, the build pipeline and the performance budget every product team ships against.

What you'll need
- 6+ years building production web applications with Vue or React
- Deep TypeScript experience
- Designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (Apollo Client, schema design)
- Track record improving Core Web Vitals on a large app

Nice to have
- Led a design system used by several product teams
- Experience shipping LLM features to customers

We offer remote work across the US, a learning budget and four weeks of paid leave.
